text:
Ava Martin: Thanks everyone — quick follow-ups from the all-hands I wanted to capture here. 1) What's the immediate ask for commercial ops on the enterprise renewal chunk in Q3? 2) How are we prioritizing partner-led deals vs self-serve expansion this quarter? 3) Any changes to the co-sell support model?
Diego Chen: Good Qs — short answers: 1) We need a cleaned pipeline deck focused on at-risk renewals + executive touches by next Tuesday EOD. 2) Prioritize partner-led for customers >$50k ARR, self-serve for bottoms-up. 3) Co-sell support is getting an enablement slot in the AE playbook (details from Priya).
Priya Rao: Adding: partner playbook v2 goes to beta next month. Focus areas: ISV integrations, joint demo templates, and a fast-track legal checklist for co-selling. I'll drop the draft in #partners and DM the pilot AEs.
Sam K.: What are the measurable targets for co-sell? is it influenced MRR or attributed closed-won?
Priya Rao: Two metrics: MRR influenced (for marketing/ops reporting) and attributed closed-won (for compensation). Quarterly target: 5 attributed co-sell deals from strategic partners this quarter.
Ava Martin: Got it. For the renewal deck — any template or data source preference? ops team should know what to pull.
Diego Chen: Use the Commercial Ops renewal template: https://redwood.work/comm-ops/renewal-template (private). Source: CRM -> "renewals" view + health signals from product telemetry. Ops-bot will post a reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Upload cleaned renewal deck by Tue 09:00 PT.
Sam K.: For escalation — if AE needs partner enablement, do they ping #partners or create a ticket? last time it was a bit scattered.
Priya Rao: Please tag #partners and @Priya for urgent enablement. We'll triage within 24 hours. For bigger needs (>3 accounts), file a partner-ops ticket so we can allocate SE time.
Ava Martin: Any change to deal routing? e.g., if a partner-led opportunity hits enterprise threshold, does it stay partner-managed or move to field?
Diego Chen: Keep it partner-managed for Q3 unless overlap with an existing enterprise AE coverage. We want to prove partner-led motion before re-routing.
Sam K.: Do we have PS support commitment for joint PoCs? last time timelines slipped.
Priya Rao: PS will prioritize partner-coordinated PoCs for strategic partners. We'll publish a runbook this week with expected SLAs (5 business days scheduling).
Ava Martin: Action items then: 1) Commercial Ops -> cleaned renewal deck template + upload by Tue 09:00 PT (assigned: ops). 2) Priya -> share partner playbook v2 draft in #partners and send pilot invites. 3) Sales -> tag #partners + @Priya for enablement; escalate via partner-ops for multi-account requests. 4) PS -> publish PoC runbook with SLAs. I'll summarize and send to leadership. :+1:
Diego Chen: Thanks all — I'll echo these in the leadership thread.
Priya Rao: Rolling this into next week's partner sync. :rocket:
Sam K.: Thanks — will prep the list of at-risk renewals and ping ops.
Ava Martin: Appreciate the quick responses. If anyone wants to add items, reply here.
ops-bot: Note: commercial ops renewal template uploaded to https://redwood.work/comm-ops/renewal-template/v2
